1.name: Building
description: You are in a one-room building.Stairs lead down.

2.name: Basement
description: This is the basement of the building.To the north is a great door
which appears to be locked from the other side.

3.name: Path
description: You are on a path which winds through the forest.The path
here bends from south to west.

4.name: cave enterance
description: The path here goes into a cave tunnel.It exits to the south.

5.name: cave exit
description: You are in the forest.To the west is the exit to a cave,
with a steep ramp preventing entry into the cave.

up.message: You can't get up the ramp.

down.message: You can't get up the ramp.

in.message: You can't get up the ramp.

6.name: Forest.
description: you are in a dense forest, with trees all around.

7.name: Forest.
description: you are in a dense forest, with trees all around.

8.name: Outside building
description: you are on a path which winds north into a dense forest.
The west end of the path goes into a small building.

9.name: Lake shore
description: You are on the southwest shore of a small lake.

north.message: I wouldn't advise you to drown yourself.

east.message: I wouldn't advise you to drown yourself.

northeast.message: I wouldn't advise you to drown yourself.

down.message: I wouldn't advise you to drown yourself.

in.message: I wouldn't advise you to drown yourself.

10.name: Observation platform
description: You are standing on an observation platform overlooking a
forest with both a lake and a building.

11.name: Light room
description: You are in a room with white,glowing chemicals on the walls.
The room is filled with a blinding light.There is an exit NE.

12.name: Volcano view
description: You are on a path going SE to E, overlooking a great active volcano.

13.name: Observatory
description: This was an observatory for the people of the ancient cities.

14.name: Spaceship
description: You are in spaceship lit by red and blue lights on it's
sides. The spaceship's manual controls are damaged.

15.name: Tunnel
description: You are in a dark north-south tunnel.

16.name: Junction of tunnels
description: You are at the junction of three tunnels, bearings N-S,
E-W, and NE-SW.

17.name: Diagonal passage
description: You are in a diagonal (NE-SW) passage.

18.name: Top of ramp.
description: You are in a room at the top of a long, steep ramp.
Passages lead north,south,east, and SE.

19.name: North of door
description: You are at the north end of a large door.
The door is locked.

20.name: Edge of bog
description: You are at the edge of a large bog.A passage leads NE.

west.message: I wouldn't advise you to drown yourself.

south.message: I wouldn't advise you to drown yourself.

southwest.message: I wouldn't advise you to drown yourself.

21.name: E/W tunnel
description: You are in an E/W tunnel with stairs going up.

22.name: E/W tunnel
description: You are in an E/W tunnel with stairs going up.

23.name: You are in a small room with stairs going north,south,and up.
description: You are in a small room with stairs going north,south,and up.

24.name: Mine enterance
description: You are at the enterance to an abandoned mine. Exits go NW and SW,
and a dark mine corridor is below.

25.name: Mine
description: You are in a dark mine corridor.  the corridor continues
up and down. The floor is a grating.

26.name: Mine
description: You are in a dark mine corridor.  the corridor continues
up and down. The floor is a grating.

27.name: Mine
description: You are in a dark mine corridor.  the corridor continues
up and down. The floor is a grating.

28.name: Carbide room
description: This room is the bottom of the mine. The ground contains
deposits of carbide (CaC) and gold.The only exit is up.

29.name: Control room
description: This room was once the control room for an ancient spaceport.
There are cspace maps, tracking devices, and other
intricate devices on the walls.

30.name: Waiting room
description: This was a waiting room for passengers on spaceships.
There are doors to the north,west,and NE.

31.name: Launching area
description: You are on a launching area for spaceships.

32.name: Strange planet
description: You are on a building on some strange planet. A door goes out.

out.message: You are on the surface on the planet, which has an atmosphere of cyanide gas.

33.name: Elevator
description: You are in an elevator.

34.name: Sphere room
description: This room has the shape of a giant sphere, with holes in all of the
major directions.

35.name: Enterance to empty barrel
description: You are in a room to the west of an empty barrel-shaped room.

36.name: Empty barrel
description: You are in a large empty barrel.

east.message: The barrel's spinning motion prevents you from moving this way.

37.name: Exit from empty barrel
description: You are east of the empty barrel.A passage goes NW.

west.message: The barrel's spinning motion prevents you from moving this way.

in.message: The barrel's spinning motion prevents you from moving this way.

barrier.message: The barrel's spinning motion prevents you from moving this way.

38.name: Recording studio
description: This is a former recording studio for Gnome Records L.T.D.

39.name: E. end of cylindrical room
description: You are at the east end of a long,cylindrical room
with a passage to the north. Written here is
"GET ME OUT OF HERE!!!"

40.name: W. end of cylindrical room
description: You are at the west end of the cylindrical room,
with a hole on the ceiling. There is an empty barrel fastened
to the floor.

41.name: Mountain passage
description: You are walking along a passage on the side of a mountain.
Below you are some ancient buildings.

42.name: You are on the north side of a giant chasm.
description: You are on the north side of a giant chasm.

description: You are on the far side of the chasm. A passage goes east to west.

46.name: This is a room with exits north and south.
description: This is a room with exits north and south.

47.name: Garbage dump
description: You are in what once was the garbage dump of the ancient cities,
although the garbage has been eaten by rats.

48.name: You are in a hall with doors west, east, and south.
description: You are in a hall with doors west, east, and south.

49.name: Dwarf city
description: You are in the city of the dwarfs. The buildings are too small
to enter. Passages go north and south.

50.name: Dwarf door
description: You are standing west of a large door, probably built by dwarfs.

51.name: you are in a short passage running E/W.
description: you are in a short passage running E/W.

52.name: Well
description: You are at the top of a well, which appears to be bottomless.

53.name: Enterance to city
description: You are at the enterance to a large and beautiful ancient city.

54.name: City
description: You are in the center of the ancient city. there are enterable
buildings on your east, west, and south. There is a path to the
north, and a road goins NW, where it is written:
"You must have at least 380 points to travel

southeast.note: Line 3090 gates on score: above 380 points the destination is room 86, otherwise the woman ends the game outright.

55.name: This was the post office for the ancient city.
description: This was the post office for the ancient city.

56.name: Space warp enterance
description: You are at the south edge of the city. On your south is a
space warp, used for instant transportation in the city long ago.

57.name: Vault of city
description: You are standing south of the vault of the ancient city, which
contains it's most valuable treasure. written on the vault:
"This vault is designed to keep out all human intruders.
